schema.title: Response My Balance Api V1 Wallet Get

get.description:
A specific tenant's balance, for support/ops. Read-only — money never moves here; it is a
money projection, not the subject's PII. `tenant` is mandatory and explicit, and audited.

schema.title: Response Operator Balance Api V1 Wallet Admin Balance Get

get.description: A specific tenant's statement, paginated (the service clamps `limit`). Audited.

schema.title: Response Operator Ledger Api V1 Wallet Admin Ledger Get

get.description:
Prove a tenant's wallet is internally consistent: sum(ledger) == the materialized balance.
A read-only integrity check for support — it computes and compares, it does not mutate. Audited.

schema.title: Response Operator Reconcile Api V1 Wallet Admin Reconcile Get

get.description: Paginated. The service clamps `limit` to LEDGER_LIST_LIMIT regardless of what is asked.

schema.title: Response My Ledger Api V1 Wallet Ledger Get

post.description: Produce a sealed, checksummed archive of the wallets, ledger, holds, and grants.

schema.title: Response Backup Export Internal Backup Export Post

post.description:
Restore an archive this service produced. Idempotent; leaves newer rows alone by default.

The declaration is passed so the ledger and wallet restore under their real composite/tenant
keys — a ledger entry restored under its led_ id would silently drop out of the seq-ordered
history reconcile() walks.

schema.title: Response Backup Import Internal Backup Import Post

post.description:
Prove an archive restores, by test-restoring it into a throwaway namespace and comparing.

The declaration is passed so the ledger's composite key ("{tenant}:{seq:012d}") and the wallet's
tenant key are reconstructed for the verify, exactly as a real restore would.

schema.title: Response Backup Verify Internal Backup Verify Post
Response Internal Health Internal Health Get
Response Internal Manifest Internal Manifest Get

post.description:
wallet holds no subject-linked data — every row is keyed by tenant.

The endpoint still exists so a DSAR can PROVE it asked. "never contacted" and "holds nothing"
are indistinguishable in an incomplete system and completely different to a regulator.

schema.title: Response Erase Subject Internal Privacy Erase Post

post.description:
The action succeeded: consume the hold. Replaying this must not charge twice.

Pass `final_net` to charge the real (usually smaller) amount instead of the reserved ceiling —
the difference is auto-released. Omit it for the full reserved amount.

schema.title: Response Confirm Internal Wallet Confirm Post

post.description: Add money. Call this only once the PSP has SETTLED — recording an intent is not money.

schema.title: Response Credit Internal Wallet Credit Post

post.description:
Emit the one-time pre-expiry notice for grants entering their fund's notice window. Scheduler-
driven, alongside sweep-grants.

schema.title: Response Notice Grants Internal Wallet Notice Grants Post

post.description:
Restore a DORMANT grant's preserved remainder to spendable — the primitive a future 'reclaim
idle balance' flow calls. Recorded: moving money back into a customer's balance is a privileged act.

schema.title: Response Reclaim Grant Internal Wallet Reclaim Post

post.description: Reverse a spend INTO THE FUNDS IT CAME FROM (a refunded gift stays a gift).

schema.title: Response Refund Internal Wallet Refund Post

post.description: The action failed: free the hold. Nothing was debited, so nothing is refunded.

schema.title: Response Release Internal Wallet Release Post

post.description: Hold funds for an in-flight action. The hold EXPIRES; it cannot strand the money.

schema.title: Response Reserve Internal Wallet Reserve Post

post.description: Direct debit. Refuses rather than overdraw, and a refusal mutates nothing.

schema.title: Response Spend Internal Wallet Spend Post

post.description: Claw back the unused remainder of expired grants. The customer keeps what they spent.

schema.title: Response Sweep Grants Internal Wallet Sweep Grants Post

post.description: Release abandoned holds. Without this a dead client locks its credits forever.

schema.title: Response Sweep Holds Internal Wallet Sweep Holds Post
Response Withdraw Internal Wallet Withdraw Post

post.description:
The payout sidecar reports the transfer's result. paid=False REVERSES the debit — a transfer
that did not happen must never cost the customer money. Idempotent on the withdrawal's state.

schema.title: Response Settle Withdrawal Internal Wallet Withdrawals Settle Post
Response Get Balance Internal Wallet  Tenant  Get

get.description:
Internal-token twin of GET /wallet/admin/ledger — a tenant's individual ledger rows for the
(cross-repo) dispute-defense report. Same bounded ledger() the self/admin routes read (the
service clamps `limit` to LEDGER_LIST_LIMIT); read-only, money never moves. Audited: an internal
caller reading a customer's money is exactly the access a review asks about.

schema.title: Response Get Ledger Internal Wallet  Tenant  Ledger Get

get.description: Prove the materialized balance equals sum(ledger). Two writes, one truth.

schema.title: Response Reconcile Internal Wallet  Tenant  Reconcile Get
